Ahmedabad University vs Silver Oak University for arts is a same-city private comparison with a wide fee gap in our records. Neither side has an NIRF rank on this page for this course.

sections.heading: Ahmedabad University vs Silver Oak University for BA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Ahmedabad University if you want a private university with a much higher recorded year tuition, at ₹4 lakh, and are ready to confirm its official arts fee and placement notices.

Choose Silver Oak University if recorded year tuition is the first filter. Our records list ₹35,000 a year for Silver Oak, and a 2021 placement row that we treat with caution because we cannot confirm it is for the arts programme.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Ahmedabad University has recorded BA tuition of ₹4 lakh a year. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed three-year total, until you check the university's current official circular.

Silver Oak University has recorded tuition of ₹35,000 a year. The gap is large. Confirm both official notices, because a recorded figure can be for a different school or admission year than the one you will join.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Ahmedabad University has no placement row on this page. Ask the university for its latest official undergraduate placement or internship report.

Silver Oak University has a recorded 2021 row, with an average package of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹12 lakh. We cannot confirm from this page that those figures are for the arts programme, so do not treat them as a BA salary promise.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. Private universities in Ahmedabad often admit BA students on Class 12 marks, with or without an interview or a university test.
Read the current official admissions page of each university for eligibility, subjects and any entrance requirement.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Ahmedabad University is a private university in the city. Silver Oak University is a separate private university campus.
If you already plan to stay in Ahmedabad, visit both campuses. The fee gap in our records is large enough that the official circular should come first.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If recorded year tuition is your first filter, Silver Oak University is far lower in our records, at ₹35,000 against Ahmedabad University's ₹4 lakh.
If you want Ahmedabad University's campus and academic brand, budget from its official circular, not from a guess, and ask for a current placement report, because this page has none.
Do not treat Silver Oak's 2021 package figures as a confirmed BA outcome until the university's official report says so.
